questions.question: What is a circle?
questions.answer: A circle is a closed shape consisting of all points that are the same distance from a fixed point called the center.

questions.question: All points on a circle are equidistant from its center.
What is the longest chord of a circle called?
Fill in the blank: The distance from the center of a circle to any point on the circle is called the ______.
What is a chord?
questions.answer: A line segment joining any two points on a circle.

questions.question: Observe the image and identify the highlighted part.
Which image shows the diameter of a circle?
The diameter is twice the radius.
Fill in the blank: A ______ is a part of the circumference of a circle.
Which part of a circle divides it into two equal halves?
What is the circumference of a circle?
questions.answer: The boundary or outer edge of the circle.

questions.question: Every diameter is also a chord.
Observe the image and identify the shaded region.
Which image represents a semicircle?
Explain the difference between a radius and a diameter.
questions.answer: A radius joins the center to the circle, while a diameter joins two points on the circle through the center.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The center of a circle is ______ from every point on the circle.
A tangent touches the circle at exactly one point.
Which line touches a circle at only one point?
What is a sector of a circle?
questions.answer: The region enclosed by two radii and the arc between them.

questions.question: Explain why the diameter is the longest chord of a circle.
questions.answer: Because it passes through the center, giving it the maximum possible length among all chords.
